title: What came between Orange River Sovereignty and Orange River Colony?
question: What came between Orange River Sovereignty and Orange River Colony?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Orange River Sovereignty (1848) to Orange River Colony (1902): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
